primary_sources.citation: Jerabek, Schwerdtfeger and Nagle, The Static Dipole Polarizability of Palladium from Relativistic Coupled Cluster Theory, arXiv:1809.08992v1.

quoted_passages.quote: For palladium, the main contribution from the sum-over-states formula of the dipole polarizability will come from 4d→5p excitations
All 46 electrons and virtual orbitals up to 30 a.u. were considered in the correlation treatment.
Our calculated value for the palladium atomic polarizability of 26.14(10) a.u.

primary_sources.electron_scope: Total neutral Pd atom, with 4d10 5s0 valence configuration; not a Kr-core-only calculation.
primary_sources.units: Atomic units of dipole polarizability, conventionally a0^3.
primary_sources.restriction: Neither 26.14(10) nor the all-electron correlation treatment supplies a separately tabulated core alpha or a rigorous upper bound for an embedded Pd core. No subtraction or substitution was made.

primary_sources.citation: W. R. Johnson, D. Kolb and K.-N. Huang, Atomic Data and Nuclear Data Tables 28(2), 333–340 (1983).
literal_abstract_quotes: Theoretical values of electric and magnetic susceptibilities ( α 1 , α 2 , χ 1 ) and shielding factors ( γ 1 , γ 2 , σ 1 ) calculated in the relativistic random-phase approximation are presented in tabular form for ions with closed 1 s , 2 p , 3 p , 3 d , 4 p , 4 d , and 5 p shells.
The table includes all ions in these sequences with nuclear charge up to Z = 56 and a representative selection of ions with 56 < Z ⩽ 92.
primary_sources.read_extent: Abstract only; actual Pd10+ alpha1 table row, units and notes were not acquired. No numerical value admitted.
not_observed: Any claim that the ionic value bounds the embedded metallic core

primary_sources.citation: Nieminen and Puska, Core Polarizabilities in Metals, Physica Scripta 25(6B), 952–956 (1982).
primary_sources.literal_quote: While the core polarizability changes relatively little (around 10%) from its free-ion value in the alkalis, Mg and Al, large increases are found for metals like Ga, Cd, In, and Sn with full d-shells.
primary_sources.read_extent: Author-institution abstract and bibliographic records; not full text.
primary_sources.finding: Supports environmental dependence of core response. The accessible abstract supplies no Pd value, electron partition or units.

core_polarizability_disposition.restriction: The neutral atom total 26.14(10) a0^3 is not a separately resolved 4s/4p core alpha or a rigorous bound for an embedded metallic core. No substitution, subtraction, oscillator-strength bound or numerical core correction is made.
